lifecycle.creation_reason: The AC-108-3 sweep executed ALL 187 handshake-native test binaries for the first time and produced a measured red surface: 154 OK, 25 FAILED, 6 ZERO_TESTS, 2 TIMEOUT. MT-108 is the capstone and must not absorb 25 upstream defects - its own V4 verdict says so explicitly (remediation item 1: resolve each failed MT through its authoritative per-MT remediation, do not suppress upstream failures inside the aggregate runner). This contract OWNS the red surface so no failing binary is lost between capstone attempts.

scope.summary: Route every binary failing the AC-108-3 full sweep to an owning microtask with evidence, so the capstone can be re-run against a green suite instead of re-discovering the same 25 failures.

zero_tests_executed.why_this_is_dangerous: A binary that executes zero tests reports "running 0 tests ... ok" and EXITS 0. Any gate keyed on exit codes counts it as coverage. These are recorded as ZERO_TESTS and MUST NOT be counted as pass. This work packet has already been bitten by this exact trap once.

RESOLVED_2026_08_13.method: Read each binary own runner output rather than inferring from the zero count.
RESOLVED_2026_08_13.finding: FOUR of the six are DELIBERATELY #[ignore]d governed live/runner-only proofs, each carrying a documented reason in its ignore message. They are NOT gaps and NOT silently missing coverage - they are exactly the class MT-108 validation_v4 verification_required names: "Execute every governed live/runner-only acceptance test separately and require green rather than counting default ignores as pass."

RESOLVED_2026_08_13.consequence_for_ac_108_3: AC-108-3 cannot be satisfied by a default sweep alone. The four governed ignores must each be run separately WITH their required environment - interactive desktop, GPU capture, supervisor identity, live backend, Palmistry binary - and required green. Counting their default-ignored exit 0 as coverage is the precise failure mode the V4 verdict called out.

timeouts: bundled_deps_audit: re-run at a 540s budget and STILL timed out, failing at 412s with "build_installer.ps1 failed". The underlying rustc exit code is 143 (SIGTERM) - the process was KILLED, not a compile error. This proof drives the installer release build with -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 -C target-feature=+crt-static, the most expensive compile in the tree. It needs a budget measured in tens of minutes and a host that is not already running parallel work-packet builds. BUDGET, not defect.

acceptance_criteria: AC-127-1: every binary in product_assertion_failures is routed to an owning microtask - existing or new - with its first panic message and the file:line it fires at recorded. No binary may be left unowned.
AC-127-2: every environmental entry either RUNS once its supervisor input is supplied, or is recorded as a typed blocker naming the exact missing input. Environmental is never treated as pass.

AC-127-3: each ZERO_TESTS binary is resolved. The four governed #[ignore]d proofs (test_drawer_integration, test_focus_audit_live, test_mt108_argus_matrix, test_no_silent_hang_end_to_end) must be RUN SEPARATELY with their documented environment and required green - a default-ignored exit 0 is never coverage. test_e7_knowledge_accesskit_argus contains literally zero tests and needs an explicit decision: populate or delete.

AC-127-4: the two build-class binaries (bundled_deps_audit, installer_build_smoke) are re-run with a budget long enough for a fat-LTO release build to COMPLETE, on a host not concurrently running other cargo builds, and their real verdict recorded. A rustc exit code of 143 is a kill, never a product verdict.
AC-127-5: no failure is closed by weakening, deleting or relaxing an assertion. Every closure is a product fix or a typed blocker with evidence.
AC-127-6: the sweep is re-run at the end with the SAME run configuration and the new totals recorded, so the red surface is measured rather than assumed to have shrunk.
proof_targets: PT-127-1: an updated ac-108-3-sweep-results.tsv from a re-run, with per-binary logs retained.
PT-127-2: for each product failure, the owning MT id and the evidence that closed it or the typed blocker that holds it open.
PT-127-3: a zero-failure, zero-ZERO_TESTS sweep, which is what AC-108-3 actually requires.
scope.risk_if_missed: MT-108 cannot honestly reach PASS. Worse, the next capstone attempt re-discovers the same 25 failures from scratch, which is precisely the waste this contract exists to prevent.

COVERAGE_HOLE_IN_THE_SWEEP_ITSELF.severity: HIGH - this invalidates any AC-108-3 count taken with --features integration alone.
COVERAGE_HOLE_IN_THE_SWEEP_ITSELF.finding: NINE test binaries are gated on the wgpu_screenshots feature as well as integration. The sweep ran with --features integration ONLY, so those binaries compiled with fewer tests - and one of them, test_e7_knowledge_accesskit_argus, is gated at FILE level with #![cfg(all(feature = "integration", feature = "wgpu_screenshots"))] and therefore reported "running 0 tests ... ok" with EXIT 0.
COVERAGE_HOLE_IN_THE_SWEEP_ITSELF.the_trap_caught_the_sweep_that_was_desig: MT-108 current_head_findings warns that a gated binary reports 0 tests and exits 0, and that any sweep MUST assert a nonzero executed count. The sweep recorded ZERO_TESTS rather than pass, which is why the hole was found - but the run configuration itself was still short one feature.

measured_delta_with_both_features.test_e7_knowledge_accesskit_argus: 0 tests -> 12 tests (11 passed / 1 FAILED). The failure is mt042_v4_canonical_argus_complete_runtime_proof at :225 with "FEMS contaminated proof tree" - the MT-042 V4 canonical Argus proof, which had never executed in this sweep at all.

COVERAGE_HOLE_IN_THE_SWEEP_ITSELF.net_effect: EIGHT of the nine are GREEN with both features and simply had under-counted coverage. ONE surfaced a genuine, previously invisible product failure (MT-042 V4 canonical Argus, FEMS contaminated proof tree). The corrected sweep totals are therefore 155 OK and 25 FAILED, with the MT-042 canonical proof newly visible.
COVERAGE_HOLE_IN_THE_SWEEP_ITSELF.required_run_configuration_correction: AC-108-3 sweeps MUST use --features integration,wgpu_screenshots. With integration alone, nine binaries under-report and one reports nothing at all while exiting 0.

rows.lesson_for_the_routing_table: This row was the ONLY one carrying an explicit action_required, and it was right to.
